hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/rainbow-springs-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('All RV sites have water and electric (20, 30 and 50 amp) and are equipped with sewer hook-ups') + Reserve Florida unit details (39 RV units: 50-amp, water, sewer), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 39 RV sites on concrete pads in Loops A-C plus 7 hike-in tent-only sites (water and 110-volt electric; park beside them). Reserve Florida lists the RV sites at 47-103 ft, nearly all back-in, two pull-through. The campground is a separate facility a few miles from the headspring; its gate is always closed and the code is given by phone (352-465-8550) on the day of arrival only. Check-in 3 p.m. or later, no early check-in.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/rainbow-springs-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Maximum RV length: 103 feet', 'All tent-only sites are hike-in sites offering water and 110 electric service', 'The campground gates are closed at all times. Please phone the campground during office hours at 352-465-8550 to obtain the gate code', 'Check-in for camping is 3 p.m. or later') + Reserve Florida search/grid and search/details for facilities 149-151 (46 units; VehicleLength 47-103; PullInTypeName), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Canoes and kayaks for rent at the campground store; fishing and tubing from the campground are for registered campers.

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/rainbow-springs-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('A dump station is located near the RV staging area', 'Amenities include a campground store, restrooms, showers and laundry', 'Canoes and kayaks are available for rent from the campground store'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on the Florida State Parks reservations website (Reserve Florida) or at 800-326-3521.

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/rainbow-springs-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521'), read 2026-10-21

note: The campground is on the Rainbow River at a separate facility a few miles from the headspring; the park says its swim area and launch are a substantial walk from the campsites. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on floridastateparks.org and Reserve Florida: 39 RV sites with 50-amp, water and sewer (plus 7 hike-in tent sites), to 103 ft with two pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump/camp store, reservable. Fees left (human-checked 2026-10-12; units still $30 + utility). Season, window and stay limits not stated for the campground (left inherited). Note corrected: it named the Withlacoochee River; the campground is on the Rainbow River.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (weak): entry is 'not waterfront'; the park page says the campground 'is located along the Rainbow River' with river access for fishing, swimming and paddling, though it also says the campground swim area/launch 'is a substantial walk from campsites'.
Phone missing: campground 352-465-8550 (floridastateparks.org: 'The phone number is 352-465-8550'); reservations 800-326-3521.
Rainbow Springs began a day-use reservation program on 2026-04-29 ('All visitors need a reservation to enter the park'); the page does not say how it applies to campers.
